Chapter 743: Chapter 30: Appearance Of The Heavenly Gate (Subscription Request)

Chapter 743: Chapter 30: Appearance of the Heavenly Gate (Subscription Request)

The items inside the box were of various shapes: hammers, swords, armors, and more.

With over a dozen of these ‘extraordinary items’ gathered together, even in this two-dimensional world that suppressed all laws, Lin Yuan could feel a strong extraordinary aura surging.

Among them, what caught Lin Yuan’s eye was a ‘tower-shaped’ extraordinary item, which emitted fluctuations of aura somewhat similar to those of a silver mirror.

“This ‘tower-shaped’ item probably also contains an independent space inside, though smaller than my mirror,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The aura emitted by the ‘tower-shaped’ item was slightly inferior to that of the silver mirror.

“But haven’t they discovered the use of this extraordinary item?” Lin Yuan glanced at Xuanyuan Dua before him.

...

If they could utilize the function of the tower-shaped item, they wouldn’t have needed this box to store over a dozen items; they could have just stored everything safely within the independent space of the tower-shaped item, inconspicuously.

Lin Yuan thought for a moment and then understood why this was the case.

Initially, to develop the capabilities of the silver mirror, he had focused his mental energy into it for almost half a day.

It nearly impacted his own strength.

At that time, Lin Yuan was already at the Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm.

Lin Yuan’s Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm was achieved by perfecting each previous realm, ultimately stepping into the nineteenth realm.

That was probably equivalent to the normal Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses at about Witch Ancestor Twenty-Fifth Realm.

Meaning, the minimum threshold to develop the tower-shaped item was the Witch Ancestor Twenty-Fifth Realm.

And the currently strongest Evolver within human civilization, Xuanyuan Dua, was barely at the Witch Ancestor Twentieth Realm.

Unless she risked everything, depleting all her mental energy, she might have been able to activate the independent space inside the tower-shaped item.

But Xuanyuan Dua would not do such a thing, as the risks involved were too great.

Should she encounter an attack from other Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses during this period, human civilization might very well be ousted prematurely, like the Tianyu Clan.

Most of the Evolvers within human civilization weren’t like Lin Yuan, hiding in some inconspicuous corner.

They established bases in the ancient country capital, needing strong warriors stationed at all times to prevent mishaps.

“I can keep half of these items if I can take them out,” Lin Yuan thought to himself as he looked over the items.

This was the promise given to him by Xia Qin Supreme Being; the more items he could take out, the more he could keep.

Of course, Lin Yuan could also choose not to take the items and instead exchange them for corresponding Merit Points to redeem other precious resources collected by human civilization.

So far, submitting Twelve-Star Strange Treasures’ weapons is one of the few means to earn a massive amount of Merit Points within human civilization.

Because each Twelve-Star Exotic Treasure’s weapon potentially aids the entirety of human civilization, its value naturally equates to Merit Points.

“Is there also an armor item?” Lin Yuan looked at the ash-gray armor in the box.

In comparison to the inner armor Lin Yuan was wearing, this armor was significantly bulkier and surely offered better defense than merely an inner armor.

“Never mind.”

“The inner armor is sufficient for my needs.”

Lin Yuan gave up on the idea of wearing the oversized armor, as its bulkiness could impair his agility.

Of course, that was a drawback specific to this two-dimensional world,

If outside, these items could change size at will, as long as they could be refined, completely transformable according to one’s desires.

“Then I’ll take it.”

Lin Yuan activated the silver mirror and directly moved the box in front of him into the mirror.

Lin Yuan had also mentioned the capabilities of the silver mirror to Xia Qin Supreme Being,

which is why the Supreme Being decided to entrust him with the custody of all the items.

One reason was his strength.

The other was convenience.

“Spatial fluctuations?”

Xuanyuan Dua was startled when she saw this scene.

To cause spatial fluctuations inside the two-dimensional world, not even an Eleventh-Rank Evolver at their peak could achieve that.

“Does this signify that Lord Xueyu possesses an item containing a complete space?” Xuanyuan Dua thought, her expression growing more respectful.

Meanwhile, she guessed which legendary Evolver from human civilization Lord Xueyu might be.

Undoubtedly, the name ‘Blood Rain’ used by Lin Yuan was a casually chosen code name to conceal his true identity.

Xuanyuan Dua, hailing from the Xuanyuan Family, one of the strongest Evolver families established by the offspring of Supreme Beings in human civilization,

knew virtually all Eleventh-Rank Evolvers in human civilization,

but she failed to find any legendary Evolver at perfect Tier 11 resembling Lin Yuan.

“Could he be from that place?” Xuanyuan Dua’s expression subtly changed.

…

When Lin Yuan met with the human civilization Evolvers, there was still a month and a half before the opening of Heavenly Gate.

But to be safe, on that afternoon, Lin Yuan led a group of human Evolvers to march towards the peak of Heavenly Mountain.

In the past, whenever the Heavenly Gate opened, it always appeared above the peak of Heavenly Mountain, the place closest to the gate.

“Human civilization’s Powerhouses have arrived.”

“The Powerhouses from human civilization within this two-dimensional world this time aren’t exceptionally remarkable, huh?”

“Who is leading them? Why haven’t we seen him before?”

“Is he that mysterious powerhouse from the Xueyu Ancient Country?”

“Why would such a mysterious powerhouse gather with human civilization?”

“Could it be that this mysterious powerhouse comes from within human civilization?”

…

On their way to the peak of Heavenly Mountain, other Powerhouses from the Myriad Clans also noticed the group of human Evolvers, and being part of the Peak Clans, they garnered attention wherever they went.
